title: Clean host word layout
statement: For natural numbers $k,l$ and a Boolean word $s$, the host word layout with both bank words empty equals the standard word assignment for $s$ on $k+l+1$ tapes.
replaced:
With both argument words erased, the host word layout for candidate $s$
equals the loop's canonical state word on $k + l + 1$ tapes carrying $s$,
including every inactive tape.
